name: ListTransitRouterMulticastGroups

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The multicast domain ID.

You must specify at least one of TransitRouterMulticastDomainId and TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.help_zh:
组播域ID。

TransitRouterMulticastDomainId或TransitRouterAttachmentId参数必须输入其中一个
parameters.name: transit_router_multicast_domain_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the multicast group.

Each multicast group is identified by a multicast IP address
parameters.help_zh:
组播组的IP地址。

每个组播组通过一个组播IP地址进行标识
parameters.name: group_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The network instance connection ID.

You must specify at least one of TransitRouterMulticastDomainId and TransitRouterAttachmentId
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例连接ID。

TransitRouterMulticastDomainId或TransitRouterAttachmentId参数必须输入其中一个
parameters.name: transit_router_attachment_id

parameters.help_en: The list of cross-region multicast domain IDs
parameters.name: peer_transit_router_multicast_domains

parameters.help_en:
The type of the multicast resource. Valid values:

VPC: queries multicast resources in a virtual private cloud (VPC).
TR: queries cross-region multicast resources
parameters.help_zh:
组播资源的类型。

VPC：表示查询专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）下的组播资源信息。
TR：表示查询跨地域的组播资源的信息
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource ID associated with the multicast resource
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query multicast sources. Valid values:

false: no.
true: yes.

This parameter is used together with IsGroupMember.
If neither parameter is configured, both multicast sources and members are queried by default.
If only one parameter is configured or both are configured, the query is based on the configured parameters
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询组播源。

false：否。
true：是。

和IsGroupMember配合使用。
若两者均不配置，则默认查询组播源和成员。
若只配置其一或两者均配置，则以配置参数为准
parameters.name: is_group_source

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query multicast members. Valid values:

false: no.
true: yes.

This parameter is used together with IsGroupSource.
If neither parameter is configured, both multicast sources and members are queried by default.
If only one parameter is configured or both are configured, the query is based on the configured parameters
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询组播成员。

false：否。
true：是。

和IsGroupMember配合使用。
若两者均不配置，则默认查询组播源和成员。
若只配置其一或两者均配置，则以配置参数为准
parameters.name: is_group_member

parameters.help_en: The list of elastic network interface (ENI) IDs
parameters.name: network_interface_ids

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TransitRouterMulticastGroups.description_en: The list of multicast group information

GroupIpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the multicast group to which the multicast resource belongs
GroupIpAddress.description_zh: 组播资源所属的组播组的IP地址

GroupMember.description_en:
Indicates whether the current multicast resource is a multicast member. Valid values:

true: The multicast resource is a multicast member.
false: The multicast resource is not a multicast member
GroupMember.description_zh:
当前组播资源是否是组播成员。

true：是组播成员。
false：不是组播成员

GroupSource.description_en:
Indicates whether the current multicast resource is a multicast source. Valid values:

true: The multicast resource is a multicast source.
false: The multicast resource is not a multicast source
GroupSource.description_zh:
当前组播资源是否是组播源。

true：是组播源。
false：不是组播源

MemberType.description_en:
The type of the multicast member. Valid values:

Static: The multicast member is manually specified.

IGMPv2: The multicast member dynamically joined the multicast group through the IGMP protocol
MemberType.description_zh:
组播成员的类型。

Static：表示当前组播成员是通过手动方式指定的。

IGMPv2：表示当前组播成员是通过IGMP协议动态加入组播组的

NetworkInterfaceId.description_en: The elastic network interface (ENI) ID, which is the multicast resource ID

PeerTransitRouterMulticastDomainId.description_en: The ID of the multicast domain associated with the cross-region multicast resource
PeerTransitRouterMulticastDomainId.description_zh: 跨地域的组播资源关联的组播域的ID

ResourceId.description_en: The resource ID associated with the multicast resource

ResourceOwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the multicast resource belongs
ResourceOwnerId.description_zh: 组播资源所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the multicast resource. Valid values:

VPC: The multicast resource is a resource in a VPC.
TR: The multicast resource is a cross-region resource
ResourceType.description_zh:
组播资源的类型。

VPC：表示当前组播资源为VPC下的资源。
TR：表示当前组播资源为跨地域的资源

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the multicast source. Valid values:

Static: The multicast source is manually specified.

IGMPv2: The multicast source dynamically joined the multicast group through the IGMP protocol
SourceType.description_zh:
组播源的类型。

Static：表示当前组播源是通过手动方式指定的。

IGMPv2：表示当前组播源是通过IGMP协议动态加入组播组的

Status.description_en:
The status of the multicast resource. Valid values:

Registering: being created.
Registered: available.
Deregistering: being deleted
Status.description_zh:
组播资源的状态。

Registering：创建中。
Registered：可用。
Deregistering：删除中

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the multicast resource belongs
VSwitchId.description_zh: 组播资源所属交换机的ID
